_comment: What it costs an Age's instability budget to be set alight, dial by dial (design 5.0, 5.2).
Difficulty you can answer: fire goes out in rain by vanilla's own rule, so an inflicted inferno in a
wet Age is a nuisance and in a dry one is a siege -- and which of those it is falls out of the Age's
own climate rather than out of anything written here.
Two dials, and either one bought sets the Age alight. `burn_damage` is how much it hurts to stand out
under open light, on top of vanilla's own burning. `light_intensity` is how dim that light may get before
the burning stops: none of it is daylight only, as a written inferno is, and all of it burns under the
moon. Both are harm, so both are dear. Opens at 4 with the other phenomena.
